title: Whitelist approval notes
summary: When a mod you suggested for the whitelist, or commented on, gets approved, a note now lands in your inbox on the main menu. The inbox window also shows notes sent to you outside of Discord, which it used to miss.
highlights: Suggested a mod and it got approved? You will hear about it on the main menu.
Inbox notes from Dungeon Train itself now show up in the window instead of a connection error.
